summary: Layer 1B expansion found one reference-context pure-play HALEU/fuel-cycle name and two underfollowed/speculative adjacent names. The highest-evidence candidate remains Centrus Energy because HALEU production/licensing is directly tied to the bottleneck. The underfollowed discovery lane is more interesting in nuclear-qualified flow-control equipment, where Flowserve has explicit nuclear pump/valve exposure and 2025 nuclear awards, and in early-stage isotope/enrichment technology via ASP Isotopes/Quantum Leap Energy, where the upside case is tied to future HALEU commercialization but the evidence remains pre-commercial and regulatory/technology-risk heavy.
